slides.headline: Is Friday the 13th bad for stocks? [We checked 61 of them]

slides.title: So, what does the data say?
paras: Since 1990 the S&P 500 closed up on <g>61%</g> of Friday the 13ths. On a normal day: 54%.

slides.title: The numbers
paras: Even without the wild March 2020 day, the average was still <g>+0.18%</g>.

slides.title: So, should you care?
paras: Nope. 61 days is a tiny sample. Not financial advice.
